title: sign: boundary_from_content not checked against content bytes
description: RFC 2046 §5.1.1 requires the boundary string to not appear in the body of any encapsulated part. sign.rs uses SHA-256(content_mime)[..16] hex as the boundary. If content_mime happens to contain that exact hex string (e.g. a message forwarding another S/MIME message whose boundary is derived the same way), the multipart structure becomes unparseable. The fix is to verify the boundary does not appear in content_mime and either add a suffix or use a random boundary.
